newsitem.title: USA: MainStreet, Commerce in definitive pact.
newsitem.headline: MainStreet, Commerce in definitive pact.

text.p: MainStreet BankGroup Inc said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement detailing the terms of its acquisition of Commerce Bank of College Park, Maryland.
It said it would pay Commerce Bank shareholders the equivalent of $52 a share for each common share and $31 per warrant for each common and preferred stock warrant.
MainStreet said that based on a recent closing price of $25.75 for its shares, the deal is valued at about $14.6 million.
The deal was first announced June 24.
MainStreet shares closed Thursday up 1/2 at 26-1/4.
